derived: from the retained rows and scores; nothing was rerun for this record
policy: rank by task-term relevance, verified dependency proximity, verified-current metadata, then path; more than one eligible target always stops; only the person's own exact path settles (ADR-046, Decision 2)
orders: 'ranked' is the shipped policy without index hints; 'index' adds the recorded real-index metadata (an offline replay, CP2 ruling); 'path_only' is the baseline
loss_rule: agent-selected losses: correct 0, wrong 1, unresolved on a decidable case 0.25; a visible abstention on an undecidable case 0

boundary_and_live.real_index: boundaries.json: train/development families rank through a real MemorySession exactly as the offline replay did (44 passed at git:6dd6b97)
boundary_and_live.live: zed-ui.json and acpx.json: the ranked stop, its order and the exact-path retry in real clients
boundary_and_live.platforms: platforms.json: P2 on Windows and WSL with every separator form

limits: the held-out gain carries the disclosed author bias
regret under D3 is the same for every order, because no order ever chooses; it is safety evidence, not benefit (CP1 ruling 4)
